name: speak
title: Speak
description: Speak text to the user via daemon-managed voice output. Blocks until playback completes.

name: browser_list_tabs
title: List browser tabs
description: List open Paseo browser tabs for this agent's workspace across connected browser automation hosts. Use returned browserId values with tab-scoped tools.

name: browser_new_tab
title: Create browser tab
description: Create a new Paseo browser tab in this agent's workspace on the most recently connected browser automation host, opened in the background without switching the user's view. Pass an http(s) URL or a scheme-less host URL, which is treated as http; the returned browserId is used by tab-scoped tools.

name: browser_snapshot
title: Snapshot browser page
description: Return a model-readable snapshot of a Paseo browser tab. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs; refs come from the latest browser_snapshot of the same tab and expire when the page changes.

name: browser_click
title: Click browser element
description: Click an element in a Paseo browser tab. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs; refs come from the latest browser_snapshot of the same tab and expire when the page changes.

name: browser_fill
title: Fill browser element
description: Fill an input-like element in a Paseo browser tab. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs; refs come from the latest browser_snapshot of the same tab and expire when the page changes.

name: browser_wait
title: Wait for browser condition
description: Wait until a Paseo browser tab contains text or reaches a URL fragment. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs; waits up to 5s by default on the browser host.

name: browser_type
title: Type into browser
description: Type text into an element, or into the focused element when ref is omitted. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs; refs come from the latest browser_snapshot of the same tab and expire when the page changes.

name: browser_keypress
title: Press browser key
description: Dispatch a keypress to an element, or to the focused element when ref is omitted. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs; refs come from the latest browser_snapshot of the same tab and expire when the page changes.

name: browser_navigate
title: Navigate browser
description: Navigate a Paseo browser tab to a URL. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs; pass an http(s) URL or a scheme-less host URL, which is treated as http.

name: browser_back
title: Browser back
description: Go back in a Paseo browser tab. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs.

name: browser_forward
title: Browser forward
description: Go forward in a Paseo browser tab. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs.

name: browser_reload
title: Browser reload
description: Reload a Paseo browser tab. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs.

name: browser_screenshot
title: Capture browser screenshot
description: Capture a PNG screenshot of a Paseo browser tab. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs. Set fullPage to true to capture the full page.

name: browser_upload
title: Upload files in browser
description: Set workspace files on a file input in a Paseo browser tab. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs; refs come from the latest browser_snapshot of the same tab and expire when the page changes.

name: browser_hover
title: Hover browser element
description: Hover an element in a Paseo browser tab. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs; refs come from the latest browser_snapshot of the same tab and expire when the page changes.

name: browser_select
title: Select browser option
description: Set a select element in a Paseo browser tab to a value. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs; refs come from the latest browser_snapshot of the same tab and expire when the page changes.

name: browser_drag
title: Drag browser element
description: Drag one element onto another in a Paseo browser tab. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs; refs come from the latest browser_snapshot of the same tab and expire when the page changes.

name: browser_logs
title: Read browser logs
description: Read recent console messages and browser performance network entries for a Paseo browser tab. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs; maxEntries defaults to 50.

name: browser_evaluate
title: Evaluate browser JavaScript
description: Evaluate a JavaScript function in a Paseo browser tab. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs; when ref is provided, refs come from the latest browser_snapshot and the resolved element is passed as the first argument.

name: browser_scroll
title: Scroll browser
description: Scroll a Paseo browser tab by deltaX/deltaY CSS pixels. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs; optional ref comes from the latest browser_snapshot and centers the wheel input over that element.

name: browser_resize
title: Resize browser viewport
description: Resize a Paseo browser tab's resident webview viewport. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs.

name: browser_close_tab
title: Close browser tab
description: Close a Paseo browser tab, remove its resident webview, and unregister it from the browser automation host. Use browserId from browser_new_tab or browser_list_tabs.

name: create_workspace
title: Create workspace
description: Create a workspace using an existing local checkout or a new Paseo-managed worktree.

path.description: Local directory or source checkout. Defaults to your current workspace. Local isolation adopts an existing directory and never creates one.

projectId.description: Existing project id to own the workspace.

background.description: True hides the workspace from default lists and the sidebar while its contents remain durable and accessible; omit background to inherit your current workspace’s value (false without a caller), and override it only when the user explicitly asks.

mode.description: Worktree creation mode. Defaults to branch-off.

branchName.description: New branch name for branch-off mode.

prNumber.description: Pull request or change request number for checkout-pr mode.

forge.description: Forge for checkout-pr mode. Defaults to the source checkout.

name: list_workspaces
title: List workspaces
description: List active workspaces.

name: archive_workspace
title: Archive workspace
description: Archive a workspace and everything it owns.

name: create_agent
title: Create agent
description: Create an agent. Agent-scoped creation defaults to your workspace and creates your subagent. Top-level creation without workspaceId creates a new local workspace. Requires provider/model (for example codex/gpt-5.4) and an initial prompt. Do not guess; call list_providers and list_models first if uncertain.

title.description: Short descriptive title (<= 60 chars) summarizing the agent's focus.

provider.description: Required provider/model pair, for example codex/gpt-5.4.

labels.description: Labels to set on the agent

settings.description: Initial runtime settings for the new agent.

modeId.description: Session mode to configure before the first run.

features.description: Provider-specific feature values, for example { fast_mode: true } for Codex.

initialPrompt.description: Required first task to run immediately after creation.

workspaceId.description: Existing workspace id. Agent-scoped calls default to the caller workspace; top-level calls create a new local workspace when omitted.

notifyOnFinish.description: Agent-scoped only: get notified when the created agent finishes, errors, or needs permission.

title.description: Short descriptive title (<= 60 chars) summarizing the agent's focus.

provider.description: Required provider/model pair, for example codex/gpt-5.4.

labels.description: Labels to set on the agent

settings.description: Initial runtime settings for the new agent.

modeId.description: Session mode to configure before the first run.

features.description: Provider-specific feature values, for example { fast_mode: true } for Codex.

initialPrompt.description: Required first task to run immediately after creation.

workspaceId.description: Existing workspace id. Agent-scoped calls default to the caller workspace; top-level calls create a new local workspace when omitted.

notifyOnFinish.description: Get notified when the created agent finishes, errors, or needs permission. Set false only for truly fire-and-forget agents.

name: send_agent_prompt
title: Send agent prompt
description: Send a task and return after dispatch acknowledgement. Calling agents receive finish notifications by default.

sessionMode.description: Optional mode to set before running the prompt.

notifyOnFinish.description: Agent-scoped only: get notified when the prompted agent finishes, errors, or needs permission.

sessionMode.description: Optional mode to set before running the prompt.

notifyOnFinish.description: Get notified when the prompted agent finishes, errors, or needs permission. Set false only for truly fire-and-forget prompts.

name: get_agent_status
title: Get agent status
description: Return the latest snapshot for an agent, including lifecycle state, capabilities, and pending permissions.

name: list_agents
title: List agents
description: List recent agents as compact metadata.

name: cancel_agent
title: Cancel agent run
description: Abort the agent's current run but keep the agent alive for future tasks.

name: archive_agent
title: Archive agent
description: Archive an agent (soft-delete). The agent is interrupted if running and removed from the active list.

name: kill_agent
title: Kill agent
description: Terminate an agent session permanently.

name: update_agent
title: Update agent
description: Update an agent name, labels, and/or runtime settings.

labels.description: Labels to set on the agent

settings.description: Runtime settings to apply to the agent.

model.description: Model ID. Pass null to clear.

thinkingOptionId.description: Thinking option ID. Pass null to clear.

features.description: Provider-specific feature values, for example { fast_mode: true } for Codex.

name: rename_workspace
title: Rename workspace
description: Rename a workspace by setting its user-visible title. Omit workspaceId to rename your current workspace.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id to rename. Omit to rename your current workspace.

name: list_workspace_scripts
title: List workspace scripts
description: List configured workspace scripts and their lifecycle, service port, proxy URL, health, and terminal ID.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID whose configured scripts to list.

name: start_workspace_script
title: Start workspace script
description: Start one configured workspace script through Paseo's managed workspace-script launcher.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID containing the configured script.

scriptName.description: Configured paseo.json script name to start.

name: stop_workspace_script
title: Stop workspace script
description: Stop a running workspace script through its supervised terminal lifecycle.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID containing the running script.

scriptName.description: Configured paseo.json script name to stop.

name: list_terminals
title: List terminals
description: List terminals for a working directory or across all working directories.

cwd.description: Optional working directory. Defaults to your current working directory.

all.description: List terminals across all working directories.

name: create_terminal
title: Create terminal
description: Create a terminal session for a working directory.

cwd.description: Optional working directory. Defaults to your current working directory.

name: kill_terminal
title: Kill terminal
description: Kill an existing terminal session.

name: capture_terminal
title: Capture terminal
description: Capture plain-text terminal output lines from a terminal session.

name: send_terminal_keys
title: Send terminal keys
description: Send literal text or special key tokens to a terminal session.

name: create_schedule
title: Create schedule
description: Create a recurring schedule that starts a new agent on a cron cadence.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the cron cadence. For example: America/New_York.

provider.description: Provider, or provider/model (for example: codex or codex/gpt-5.4). Defaults to the caller's provider in an agent-scoped session.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the cron cadence. For example: America/New_York.

provider.description: Provider, or provider/model (for example: codex or codex/gpt-5.4). Defaults to the caller's provider in an agent-scoped session.

name: create_heartbeat
title: Create heartbeat
description: Create a recurring heartbeat that sends you a prompt on a cron cadence.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the cron cadence. For example: America/New_York.

name: delete_heartbeat
title: Delete heartbeat
description: Delete one of your heartbeats.

name: list_schedules
title: List schedules
description: List all schedules managed by the daemon.

name: inspect_schedule
title: Inspect schedule
description: Inspect a schedule and its run history.

name: pause_schedule
title: Pause schedule
description: Pause an active schedule.

name: resume_schedule
title: Resume schedule
description: Resume a paused schedule.

name: delete_schedule
title: Delete schedule
description: Delete a schedule permanently.

name: update_schedule
title: Update schedule
description: Update an existing schedule. Only provided fields are changed; omitted fields remain unchanged.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for cron cadence; requires cron. For example: America/New_York.

maxRuns.description: New max runs limit (null to clear).

model.description: New model for new-agent target (null to clear).

mode.description: New mode for new-agent target (null to clear).

name: schedule_logs
title: Schedule logs
description: Get the run history (logs) for a schedule.

name: run_schedule_once
title: Run schedule once
description: Run a schedule immediately without changing its cron cadence.

name: list_providers
title: List providers
description: List configured agent providers, availability, and their modes.

name: list_models
title: List models
description: List models for an agent provider.

name: list_profiles
title: List agent profiles
description: List agent profiles: named provider/model/mode bundles a human configured for specific kinds of work. Read each profile's `notes` to pick the one that fits the task you're delegating, then copy its `provider`, `model`, `modeId`, `thinkingOptionId`, and `featureValues` into create_agent (there is no `profile` parameter). Returns an empty list if none are configured.

name: inspect_provider
title: Inspect provider
description: Inspect compact provider capabilities for orchestration, including modes and draft feature settings. Use list_models for the full model list.

provider.description: Provider ID, optionally with a model ID (for example codex or codex/gpt-5.4).

cwd.description: Working directory used to resolve provider feature availability.

settings.description: Draft provider settings used to compute available features.

name: get_agent_activity
title: Get agent activity
description: Return recent agent timeline entries as a curated summary.

limit.description: Optional limit for number of activities to include (most recent first).

name: set_agent_mode
title: Set agent session mode
description: Switch the agent's session mode (plan, bypassPermissions, read-only, auto, etc.).

name: list_pending_permissions
title: List pending permissions
description: Return all pending permission requests across all agents with the normalized payloads.

name: respond_to_permission
title: Respond to permission
description: Approve or deny a pending permission request with an AgentManager-compatible response payload.
